title: LOTO the tipper and remove the station side panel to access the motor for Timing Pulley Replacement
summary: Perform lockout/tagout (LOTO) for the specific tipper being serviced, then remove the station side panel (by removing nine self-tapping fasteners if needed) to access the motor area prior to Timing Pulley Replacement.
when_to_use: Use when you must service the tipper’s motor area for Timing Pulley Replacement and need safe physical access by applying LOTO and removing the station side panel.
not_for: Do not proceed with side panel removal if you cannot confirm LOTO is correctly applied to the tipper.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Apply and verify LOTO for the specific tipper being serviced; perform physical removal of the station side panel to access the motor.
safety_notes: Apply LOTO to the tipper using the manual’s referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure on page 2 before accessing the motor area.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station
Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure (page 2 reference in the manual)

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper to be serviced is identified so the correct unit is LOTO’d.
external_references: OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual v3 — "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2 (referenced by the Timing Pulley Replacement removal steps).

visual_references.description: Exploded view of the Timing Pulley assembly (includes the LOTO + side panel removal prerequisites shown in the Timing Pulley Replacement removal section).

steps.title: Identify the specific tipper and perform LOTO
steps.purpose: Ensure the correct tipper is isolated and safe before any physical access work.
steps.instruction: Identify the specific tipper to be serviced. Perform LOTO for that tipper using the manual’s referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure on page 2.
steps.expected_result: The tipper being serviced is locked out/tagged out.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is correctly applied to the specific tipper prior to proceeding to side panel removal.
steps.failure_condition: LOTO cannot be confirmed as correctly applied to the tipper.

actions.label: Apply LOTO to the tipper
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-verify LOTO is correctly applied before proceeding if lockout/tagout cannot be confirmed.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.19.1: REMOVAL step 1: "LOTO the tipper (see \"Operator Station Lockout/Tagout\" on page 2)."

steps.title: Remove the station side panel (remove nine self-tapping fasteners if necessary)
steps.purpose: Gain physical access to the motor area by removing the station side panel.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing fasteners on the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: The nine self-tapping fasteners are removed (if needed) and the station side panel is removed, exposing the motor area.
steps.healthy_condition: Station side panel is removed and the motor area is accessible after fasteners are removed.
steps.failure_condition: The side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine self-tapping fasteners.

actions.label: Remove side panel fasteners
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine self-tapping fasteners, stop and escalate for assistance rather than forcing the panel.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.19.1: REMOVAL step 2: "If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor."

success_criteria: Station side panel is removed and the motor area is accessible.
healthy_conditions: LOTO is correctly applied to the specific tipper before proceeding.
Station side panel removal succeeds after removing the nine self-tapping fasteners (if needed), resulting in motor area access.
failure_conditions: LOTO cannot be confirmed as correctly applied to the tipper.
Station side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine self-tapping fasteners.
escalation_guidance: If the side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine self-tapping fasteners, stop and escalate for assistance rather than forcing the panel.
